_comment: Iter 3, Phase 1 — wavelet_net (cache miss, new model, score=6.3).
key_findings: Score 6.3 beats spectral_net SOTA (6.1) by +0.2 — wavelet multi-resolution adds further coverage.
Files 0-2 now score 2.0-3.0 — very low frequencies partially recovered for the first time.
bottlenecks: Wavelet decomposition depth is a sensitive hyperparameter — too deep loses temporal resolution.
Training time 3× wavenet — multi-resolution decomposition is expensive.
best_config_analysis: wavelet_levels=3, spectral_channels=16 optimal. Deeper levels overfit on low-freq files.
frequency_analysis: Files 0-2 score 2-3. Files 3-9 score 5-7. Files 10-19 score 8-9.
data_sensitivity: High — would benefit from more rounds. Trial mode limiting performance.
efficiency_assessment: 3× compute vs wavenet, +0.72 over wavenet score. Reasonable for the gain.
strategy_assessment: Combining spectral_gating with multi-resolution is the productive direction.

_comment: Iter 3, Phase 2 synthesis — 5 models (4 cached + wavelet_net new).
key_findings: wavelet_net (6.3) is new SOTA. Three iterations of spectral-domain exploration confirm a clear trend.
spectral_gating appears in all three top-performing models — a genuinely reusable mechanism.
bottlenecks: Files 0-2 still the hardest — even wavelet_net only partially addresses very low frequencies.
Compute cost scaling with each generation: wavenet(1×) → spectral_net(2×) → wavelet_net(3×).
frequency_comparison: Progressive improvement on low-freq files across 3 generations. The trend is clear.
efficiency_comparison: wavenet still most efficient. wavelet_net best absolute score at highest compute.
take_home_message: spectral_gating is now confirmed across 3 independent models — it should be promoted to canonical vocabulary. Next step: reduce compute overhead while preserving spectral coverage.

_comment: Iter 3, dedup call — spectral_gating promoted, checking against existing canonical features.
rationale: spectral_gating (learnable spectral gates on frequency-domain representations) is distinct from all existing canonical features such as dilated_causal_conv, multi_head_attention, and focal_loss. It describes a frequency-domain gating mechanism not captured by any current entry.
